description:
The Engwe LE20 is the latest innovation in cargo electric bikes, designed to embody the slogan "One Bike, Endless Possibilities". As Engwe's first foray into the cargo bike market, the LE20 combines the best features of longtail e bike and compact electric bike, with both impressive capacity and unique advantages.
Key Highlights of the Engwe LE20
1. Super large battery, super long range
The LE20 is a super range electric cargo bike, available in single and dual battery options, with the dual battery version boasting a massive 1843Wh capacity (48V 38.4Ah) and a range of up to 211 miles. This is 1.5 times higher than most cargo electric bikes, ensuring you can travel further without worrying about running out of power.
2. Easy and fast charging for unimpeded travel
With 8A fast charging technology, the LE20's battery charges quickly, saving you time and enabling seamless daily use. A single fast charge can last up to 7 days under normal use, adding convenience to your travels.
3. Strong power, high torque
Equipped with a powerful hub motor, this electric utility bike delivers 1300W peak power and 75Nm torque. This feature enables it to handle a variety of terrains effortlessly, making it perfect for family errands, outdoor adventures, and even tool bag transport.
4. Thoughtful design, reliable safety
Riding safety is of utmost importance, so we took many aspects into consideration when designing the LE20. It is UL2849 certified and meets strict US safety standards. As a safeguard, this e cargo bicycle is equipped with a turn signal taillight, front and rear lights, brake lights, 180mm hydraulic disc brakes, a sturdy frame, and puncture-proof tires to ensure rider safety. You can use it as a family ebike, dog cargo bike, electric deliver bike, etc.
5. Comfortable riding, excellent experience
The bike is equipped with a torque sensor for a natural riding feel; its front fork suspension enhances stability and comfort. These features combine to provide an excellent riding experience, setting the LE20 apart from other electric cargo bikes.
6. Multiple accessories for easy loading
We also offer a range of accessories that allow you to customize the bike to your specific needs, maximizing storage space and making it easy to transport all your cargo.
In short, the Engwe LE20 is more than just a cargo bike; it is a versatile and powerful tool designed to meet a variety of needs while prioritizing comfort, safety and efficiency. Whether it's daily errands or adventure outings, the LE20 can adapt and perform well.
